items.quote: I don't rate Chidi's cardio all that much

items.claim: Chidi Njokuani fights exclusively off the back foot and lets opponents work.
items.quote: he lets guys kind of work off of the front foot while he elects to counter strike.

items.claim: Chidi Njokuani has lost some of his physicality and punching power down at 170 pounds as he gets older.
items.quote: while he's not dealing with these bigger, stronger athletes, I think he's giving up a little bit of physicality. I think he's giving up a little bit of that pop that you would normally see at the end of his strikes and he's getting older.

items.claim: Joel Alvarez will bring a higher pace and outwork Chidi Njokuani.
items.quote: Joel Alvarez is going to be able to bring a pace to this fight that is just going to be a little bit more.

items.claim: Jalin Turner can slap on a choke very quickly, posing a submission threat if the fight goes to the mat.
items.quote: Jalin Turner can just slap a choke on you really quickly.

items.claim: Kalil Fernandez excels on the feet and outstrikes many fighters in the division.
items.quote: I think on the feet, he's out striking a lot of guys in this division.
